services.title: On-Site Tech Support
services.headline: In-home help when you need it.
services.summary: Get in-person help with Wi-Fi, printers, new devices, account access, and other problems that are easier to solve on-site.

services.title: Virus and Malware Removal
services.headline: Remove infections and secure your system.
services.summary: Remove viruses, pop-ups, browser hijackers, and other malware. We also help secure the computer and reduce the risk of another infection.

services.title: Wi-Fi and Network Setup
services.headline: Reliable Wi-Fi and network setup for homes and small offices.
services.summary: Set up or fix routers, mesh Wi-Fi, access points, and wired connections for a faster, more reliable home or small-office network.

services.title: Home Network and Wi-Fi Security
services.headline: Make your home Wi-Fi and connected devices safer without making them harder to use.
services.summary: Improve your home or small-office network with safer router settings, guest Wi-Fi, device separation, and fewer risky defaults.

services.title: Scam and Fraud Protection
services.headline: Practical help spotting scams and protecting yourself online.
services.summary: Get practical help after a scam, suspicious message, or near miss. We help secure affected accounts and show you how to recognize similar scams.

services.title: Password Manager Setup and Account Security
services.headline: Set up a password manager and clean up risky login habits.
services.summary: Set up a password manager, replace weak or reused passwords, and improve account security without making daily sign-ins harder.

services.title: Computer Repair
services.headline: Help for slow, crashing, or non-booting computers.
services.summary: Get help with a slow, crashing, overheating, or non-booting computer. We diagnose the problem and explain whether repair or replacement makes sense.

services.title: Data Recovery and Backup Help
services.headline: Recover important files and stop future loss.
services.summary: Recover deleted files or data from a failing drive when possible. We can also set up a backup plan to reduce the risk of future data loss.

services.title: Laptop and PC Upgrades
services.headline: Speed up a computer that is still worth keeping.
services.summary: Speed up a computer that is still worth keeping with an SSD, more memory, a replacement battery, or a system cleanup.

services.title: Software Troubleshooting and Installation
services.headline: Fix Windows and Mac software problems without a full wipe.
services.summary: We troubleshoot failed updates, driver problems, sign-in issues, app crashes, and software installations before recommending a full reset.

services.title: Smart Home Setup and Security
services.headline: Set up cameras, doorbells, and smart devices with clearer privacy and fewer headaches.
services.summary: Set up cameras, doorbells, speakers, hubs, and other smart devices for reliable use, safer access, and better privacy.

services.title: Custom Technology Solutions
services.headline: Start with a consultation when the job does not fit a standard service page.
services.summary: Start with a consultation for technology projects that need planning, equipment choices, or a custom setup.
